answer: Run short random walks of trust from a few audited seed agents, like dye released at dawn from a knoll and followed downhill. Honest agents trade widely, so the trust spreads to them within a few hops; a sybil farm hangs off the real economy by only a handful of edges, so only a thin plume of trust ever reaches it. Rewards scale with the trust each identity ends up holding, so spinning up a thousand fake accounts still splits the same trickle instead of multiplying it.
